sensitivity_analysis.methodology: One-at-a-time ±50% perturbation of uncertain model parameters only (probabilities clipped to [0, 1], hop counts rounded to integers >= 1, consequence weights re-normalised to sum = 1.0). Normalisation constants, log-scale bounds, compound-hazard rules, and remediation costs are definitions/inputs and held fixed.

most_influential_parameters: Persona hop limit: Insider max_hops (min Kendall's τ = 0.394, up to 10/10 rank positions shifted)
Exploit probabilities (EPSS / CVE edge probabilities × multiplier) (min Kendall's τ = 0.956, up to 2/10 rank positions shifted)
Anomaly boost ALPHA (p' = p + (1 - p) × ALPHA × score) (min Kendall's τ = 0.956, up to 2/10 rank positions shifted)
sensitivity_analysis.honest_assessment: The top-10 ranking is most sensitive to persona hop limits (cutting nation-state max_hops from 8 to 4 prevents multi-stage chains from reaching deeper L1/L0 OT controllers via the corporate/DMZ path) and to exploit/credential probabilities on choke-point gateways. Varying KEV_FLOOR between 0.25 and 0.75 and consequence weights by ±50% preserves the top-tier water and power OT priority assets with high concordance.

anomaly_evaluations.separation_note: Synthetic network-flow anomaly detection and HAI 21.03 physical process telemetry anomaly detection evaluate different signal domains and datasets; they are reported separately and never merged into a single metric.

synthetic_evaluation.label: Synthetic data, injected attacks
synthetic_evaluation.notes: Trained on first 5 days baseline; evaluated on final 2 days containing 6 injected attack windows across IT/DMZ/OT.

hai_testbed_evaluation.label: HAI 21.03 real testbed data
hai_testbed_evaluation.process_target: attack_P3 (water-treatment process: pumping between reservoirs, Siemens S7-300 PLC)
hai_testbed_evaluation.protocol:
IsolationForest baseline on HAI 21.03 water-treatment (P3) tags.
Protocol fixed before looking at test results:
- train on train1 (normal operation only), features = 7 P3 tags + 1-step differences + 60 s rolling std, standardised on train
- threshold = 99.5th percentile of TRAIN anomaly scores (no test tuning)
- alarm = 30 s rolling mean of score above threshold
- report point-wise precision/recall against attack_P3 and event-level recall (share of attack_P3 segments with >= 1 alarm)
hai_testbed_evaluation.note: Point-wise and event-level metrics, not eTaPR. HAI recommends eTaPR for comparison with published results; do not compare these numbers to HAICon leaderboards. Baseline only: one model, one threshold fixed from training data, no tuning on test files.

kev_floor_evidence.definition: ICS KEV = KEV CVE that also appears in a CISA ICS (CSAF OT) advisory.
kev_floor_evidence.small_sample_note: Note: The water-sector KEV sample is small (17 KEV CVEs, 16 with EPSS scores; median EPSS = 0.0936, 50% below 0.10). Present this as an empirical indication motivating the water-sector KEV_FLOOR = 0.50 correction rather than a universal statistical law.
